Disclosure to Promote the Right To Information 

Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority, 
and whereas the attached publication of the Bureau of Indian Standards is of particular interest 
to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public.

DIMENSIONS OF DRIVING SYSTEM OF TOOL 
CHUCKS ( END MILL HOLDERS ) WITH CLAMP SCREWS 
FOR FLATTED PARALLEL SHANK TOOLS 



1. Scope — Specifies dimensions of driving system of tool chucks ( end mill holders ) with clamp 
screws designed for driving of flatted parallel shanks conforming to IS : 8692-1978 'Dimensions for 
parallel shanks for mi^lling cutters'.

3. Tolerances — Tolerances on dimensions wherever not specified shall be of grade 'medium' 
according to IS : 2102 ( Part 1 )-1980 'General tolerances for dimensions and form and position: 
Part I General tolerances for linear and regular dimensions ( second revision )\

EXPLANATORY NOTE 

In the preparation of this standard considerable assistance has been derived fronr> 
DIN : 1835 (Part II )-1978 'Connecting dimensions for clamping chucks accessories' issued by 
Deutsches Institut fur Normung (DIN) and ISO 5414-1985 'Tool chucks (end mill holders) 
with clamp screws for flatted parallel shank tool, Part 1 Dimensions of the driving system of tool 
shanks\ issued by the International Organization for Standardization( ISO ).
